name: American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional
old_description: Champion® brand: giving you the confidence to play by your own rules Since 1919.
about:
American Ink Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promotional has operated from Sioux Falls, South Dakota since 1919. The company is an owned-and-operated screen printing, embroidery, and promotional product business serving the greater Midwest region.

The shop provides in-house screen printing and embroidery, specializing in 8-color spot process along with discharge, puff, and glitter inks. It also offers custom design services, web store and fundraiser platforms, and wholesale programs. The company stocks thousands of apparel styles — including t-shirts, jackets, polos, caps, and sweatshirts — from brands such as Bella+Canvas, Carhartt, Under Armour, and Richardson, plus promotional items from Bic, Koozie, and Titleist.

Customers range from businesses and corporate events to charitable organizations, spirit clubs, athletic teams, and schools. Orders are produced to exact specifications, with quantity tiers starting at six pieces and scaling to 200-plus.

American Ink emphasizes turnaround speed and competitive pricing, completing all decoration in-house to maintain quality control. A recent addition is free delivery within a five-mile radius of the Sioux Falls facility.

name: American Iron Works
old_description: At American Iron Works, we offer custom made-to-order metal fabrications in Iron, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Bronze and more. We can design any style to fit the aesthetic of your commercial space, residential home, or any custom piece you desire. With over 40 years of experience and a great passion for our trade, we ensure our customers across Connecticut will receive high-quality products and services. Contact us at
about:
American Iron Works operates from a shop in New Haven, Connecticut. The business traces its roots back over 40 years to a passion for metal craft held by Pasquale, the father and grandfather of the current owners. Today it is a third‑generation, family‑owned company led by Anthony and Joe Maresca, who have grown the operation into a full‑service fabrication and installation house serving clients across Connecticut.

The company produces custom ornamental metal fabrications in iron, stainless steel, aluminum, and bronze. Its in‑house capabilities span welding (Stick, MIG, TIG), metal forming (grinding, cutting, chamfering, bending, punching, shearing, and CNC plasma cutting), and finishing (sandblasting, powder coating, galvanizing, and patinas). Every project moves through material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and installation under one roof, with each piece inspected before it leaves the shop.

American Iron Works serves both commercial and residential customers. Commercial projects have included fire‑escape renovations, steel mezzanines, anti‑climb fencing, and custom partition walls for office and retail spaces. Residential work ranges from hand‑forged stair rails and Juliet balconies to aluminum pergolas, cable‑rail systems, and decorative gates. The shop also fabricates specialty items such as sunburst panels, branch‑textured railings, and custom signage.

The Maresca brothers emphasize fine craftsmanship, custom design, and efficiency as the pillars of their reputation. They attribute their longevity to a hands‑on approach that controls every step from raw material to final installation, ensuring each client receives a unique, detail‑oriented piece.

name: American Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Metal Fabricators has a proven history fabricating with a variety of materials including steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
about:
American Metal Fabricators was founded in 1988 in Gastonia, North Carolina, just outside Charlotte. The company operates as a custom metal fabrication shop and has served the region for over three decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company fabricates a wide range of custom equipment including air washers, air handling units, foam panels, energy recovery systems, dryers, ovens, furnaces, plenums, duct systems, dust filtration equipment, gas turbine filtration, mining equipment, humidification systems, mist eliminators, acoustic enclosures, scrubbers, spray systems, and evaporative cooling systems. It operates from a 200,000-square-foot manufacturing facility with a dedicated 30,000-square-foot sandblast building, high-bay overhead cranes, and drive-through truck access. The workforce includes welders, fabricators, pipefitters, electricians, machinists, painters, mechanics, designers, drafters, schedulers, expediters, QA/QC inspectors, and sales staff. Equipment includes 15 press brakes (up to 14 feet, 400+ tons), five shears (1/2-inch capacity, 12 feet), four plasma cutting tables (10 feet wide by 40 feet long), laser cutters, a 500-foot rail paint line with downdraft booth, foam panel injection equipment, and rolling capabilities for angle ring, pipe, and channel.

American Metal Fabricators serves industries such as power generation, utilities, microelectronics, paper, pulp, fibers, textiles, wood, furniture, food and beverage, chemicals, plastics, paint, printing, heavy equipment, and pharmaceuticals. Customers include utilities, industrial equipment manufacturers, and facilities requiring custom metal enclosures and filtration systems.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle complex jobs with short lead times, supported by a large skilled labor force that allows rapid expansion. It is equipped for both large-scale projects and special handling of smaller orders, with in-house capabilities spanning welding, forming, blasting, painting, rolling, assembly, and foam panel manufacturing.

name: American Precision Products
old_description: A leading supplier of custom injection molded products since 1972 American Precision Products can handle your molding program.
about:
American Precision Products was founded in 1972 in Huntsville, Alabama. The company operates as a custom injection molding firm serving commercial, aerospace, and government markets. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company molds thermoplastics, thermoplastic elastomers, and thermoset materials, including filled and modified resins. Its processes encompass custom injection molding, compression molding, transfer molding, insert molding, overmolding, and miniature and micro molding. Additional services include prototyping, in-house mold building and tooling, and overseas tooling sourcing. Production runs range from low volume to high volume, with micro molding capabilities on dedicated high-speed presses since 1987.

American Precision Products serves military, aerospace, and commercial industries. The firm emphasizes highly controlled manufacturing specifications—tolerances, cosmetics, and production control measures—tailored for aerospace and military applications. Customers include government agencies and commercial OEMs requiring precision molded components.

The company positions its injection molding as faster, more accurate, and more repeatable than traditional compression and transfer molding, offering a path to cost savings and quality improvements for existing programs. Its differentiators include micro molding expertise since 1987, in-house tooling, and the ability to manage both short and long production runs.

about:
American Sewing Workroom, LLC operates as a family-owned business in Roswell, Georgia, within the metro Atlanta area. The company serves as a one-stop shop for established clothing lines and newcomers to the garment industry, offering services from concept through pattern making, grading, prototyping, cutting, sewing, and embroidery.

The workroom handles each phase of production with skilled technicians and product development specialists. Its CEO is a professional tailor with extensive fashion industry experience, capable of creating patterns from initial ideas. The facility provides cut-and-sew services built on pattern-making expertise, though specific facility size, headcount, and volume metrics are not disclosed.

ASW produces clothing lines for women's and children's fashion designers, both local and out-of-state. The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, stating pride in making products in the United States.

The company differentiates itself through attention to detail described as unparalleled in the industry, with a focus on quality and reliable service across every step of production development.

name: American Sheet Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Sheet Metal Fabricators, Inc. “ASM” is a developed Union Local 73 fabrication shop in Chicagoland’s south side.  At American Sheet Metal Fabricators Inc, we are dedicated to providing our customers with high quality products and services at affordable prices. We value your business. We have made it our mission to provide reliable products and services in our customer-driven approach.
about:
American Sheet Metal Fabricators, Inc. (ASM) operates a Union Local 73 fabrication shop in South Holland, Illinois, on Chicago’s south side. The business is led by members of the DeBartolo family: Dennis DeBartolo serves as president, Frank DeBartolo as vice president, Anthony DeBartolo as superintendent, and Christine DeBartolo as treasurer. The company does not disclose its founding year.

ASM produces HVAC ductwork and fittings in a variety of configurations. Its capabilities include lockforming rectangular straight duct and fittings, snaplock and Pittsburgh lock fabrication, welded construction of rectangular and round duct (with TIG welding available), double-wall rectangular and spiral duct with solid or perforated inner liners, and spiral pipe from 4 to 40 inches in diameter. The shop also installs acoustical liner (Armaflex, Armacell), fabricates roof caps, custom drain pans, roof curbs, platform curbs, and roof rails, and supplies accessories such as canvas, Ductmate frames, TDF hardware, sealers, and screws. Additional services include end wrapping, custom register and linear boxes, painted pipe chase covers, painted duct, pre-assembled duct runs with collars and taps installed, and cut-to-size cleats and drives. All work is fabricated to SMACNA standards.

The company serves mechanical and HVAC contractors, with testimonials referencing customers such as EMCOR Team. Its product line covers commercial and residential applications, including roof-top units, residential plenums, and return-air elbows available for same-day pick-up.

ASM emphasizes a customer-driven approach, offering high-quality products at reasonable prices. Differentiators include a large inventory of low-pressure snaplock pipe and fittings, same-day pick-up for select items, and pre-assembled duct runs delivered sealed and ready to install.

The business functions as a retailer and installer of aftermarket parts and accessories for pickup trucks, SUVs, and off-road vehicles. Its service offerings include custom fabrication projects, interior and exterior coating applications, and DINITROL rust proofing. The company stocks and sells products from brands such as Rampage Products, Buyers Products Company, and ZROADZ Off Road Products, and promotes a “buy a part, we can install it” model for customers.

name: American Wire Group
old_description: AWG specializes in providing wire and cable solutions for use in wind, solar, battery energy storage and EV infrastructure applications.
about:
American Wire Group (AWG) is headquartered in Aventura, Florida, with operation centers in Perris, California; Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania; and Katy, Texas. The company marks 25 years in business, having grown into a national supplier of wire, cable, hardware, and equipment for utility and renewable energy markets.

AWG manufactures and supplies a range of wire and cable products including aluminum, copper, steel, and fiber‑optic cables, as well as poles, pole‑line hardware, and accessories. Its value‑added services cover cable management and logistics, custom engineering and design, supply‑chain optimization, and emergency response. The company operates coast‑to‑coast warehouses and offers customization such as cut‑to‑length, paralleling, and custom labeling, along with reel disposal and specialty cable constructions.

The company serves utilities, renewable‑energy developers (wind, solar, battery energy storage), data‑center operators, EV and hydrogen‑fueling infrastructure projects, power transmission and distribution networks, substations, and industrial facilities. Government agencies and emergency‑response teams also rely on AWG for rapid material deployment during disaster recovery.

AWG emphasizes its extensive inventory and nationwide warehouse network as key differentiators, enabling delivery in days rather than weeks. Its ISO 9001:2015‑certified quality system and 24/7 emergency response capability are positioned as core reasons customers choose the company for mission‑critical projects.

name: American Wood Design, Inc.
old_description: Award-Winning Commercial Cabinetry & Architectural Millwork Since 1996
about:
American Wood Design, Inc. is a family-owned commercial cabinetry and architectural millwork shop based in Chester, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 1996 by Michael Gilhool Sr., who launched the business above a doctor's office in South Philadelphia after his previous employer closed its display shop. Gilhool bartered the shop's machinery for cabinetry work, and the operation later spent nearly two decades at Naamans Road Business Park before moving to a 16,000-square-foot facility in Chester in 2017.

The shop produces custom cabinets, countertops, reception desks, nurse stations, and a full range of architectural millwork including office front systems, wall paneling, and custom trim. Its equipment includes a computerized beam saw, CNC router, and edgebander driven by dedicated software, allowing both high-volume production runs and the flexibility to handle small projects. Services also cover plastic laminate layups with a 3–5 day turnaround, solid surface and stone countertop fabrication, and ongoing maintenance and repair work.

The company serves commercial contractors, architects, and facility managers across the Greater Philadelphia region. Typical projects span office fit-outs, healthcare environments, and retail spaces, with concrete examples including custom reception desks for corporate lobbies, nurse stations for medical facilities, and wholesale plastic laminate panel layups for trade customers.

The founding mission — to build cabinetry and relationships that last a lifetime — emphasizes on-time, on-budget craftsmanship. Gilhool's original impetus was turning a layoff into an opportunity, and the business continues to stress quick turnaround, competitive pricing on wholesale press jobs, and a willingness to handle service calls and modifications long after installation.

name: Americor Electronics Ltd
old_description: Manufacturing power cords, cable & wire harnesses and other electric and electronic components for the world since 1988.
about:
Americor Electronics Ltd. was founded in 1988 in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, by Tom Pross, who brought 22 years of experience in power cord, cable, and wire harness production. Pross leveraged his supplier relationships worldwide to establish the company as a privately held supplier of electrical and electronic components.

The company manufactures custom and standard power cords, cable assemblies, and wire harnesses, along with a range of electronic components including solenoids, relays, axial fans, terminal blocks, piezoelectric devices, EMI/RFI filters, transformers, and adapters. It provides prototyping, testing, documentation for approval, and post‑order inventory management and shipping. Americor also serves as the U.S. manufacturer’s representative for Germany’s Adels Contact, supplying terminal blocks, connector systems, and distribution boxes for high‑power LEDs.

Americor sells exclusively to original equipment manufacturers and distributors, serving the appliance, electronics, and medical device sectors. Longtime customers include Pulsafeeder, an Idex Corporation business, which named Americor its Supplier of the Year in 2019. The company has supported OEM product development for over three decades.

Pross started the business to offer custom‑engineered products that guarantee maximum function and cost efficiency, backed by a commitment to stay current with certifications such as ISO 9001:2015 and RoHS compliance. The firm emphasizes ongoing service, managing inventory and logistics for clients after the initial order.
